summary_en: Tokyo Printing Ink announced execution of 150,000 shares acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 at 2,076 yen per share on November 9, 2026, with maximum acquisition amount of 311.4 million yen. This represents execution under the 800,000-share framework authorized by the board on August 5, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Market Purchases and Off-hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Tokyo Printing Ink executed acquisition of 150,000 treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on November 9, 2026. The purchase price was fixed at 2,076 yen per share, the closing price on November 6, 2026, for a total acquisition amount of 311.4 million yen. This execution represents 1.2% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

This purchase was executed as part of a broader 800,000-share acquisition framework authorized by the board on August 5, 2026, with an upper limit of 1.2 billion yen and acquisition period through March 31, 2027. Methods include both market purchases through agency trading and ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. As of November 6, 2026, the company had cumulatively acquired 254,900 shares for 518.8 million yen under this framework.
